output.response_text:
Dear Enterprise Client 6,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We understand how frustrating it can be to be locked out of your account after updating your phone number, and we’re here to help you regain access as quickly as possible.

To resolve this issue, we will need to verify your identity and confirm the new phone number you entered. Once verified, we will reset the multi‑factor authentication (MFA) challenge and clear the temporary lockout flag on your account.

Below are the steps we’ll take together:

- Verify your identity using our standard Enterprise verification procedures (security questions or corporate email confirmation).
- Confirm the new phone number you entered and ensure it is active and able to receive SMS messages.
- Review the OTP delivery logs for the phone‑number update to determine if the OTP was sent successfully.
- If the OTP was not delivered or was entered incorrectly, we will generate a new OTP and send it to the confirmed phone number, or offer an alternative MFA method (authenticator app or backup email).
- Once you successfully complete the MFA verification, we will manually clear the temporary lockout flag in our account management console.
- Finally, we will verify that you can log in and that MFA is functioning correctly before closing the ticket.

We appreciate your cooperation and will keep you updated throughout the process. Please let us know the requested information at your earliest convenience so we can proceed.

Best regards,
Enterprise Support Team
